turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's your day been so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A bit tired today, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My neighbour's sycamore has grown so much it shades my whole veg patch now. I'm fuming.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's frustrating. You've got two routes, move the beds into the sunny side, or keep them and switch to crops that tolerate shade. Which feels less painful?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hmm, wait forty-five seconds and then ask me again, okay?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: So, shift the beds or change what you grow?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Switch crops. I haven't got the back for moving soil.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then lettuce, chard, peas and herbs like parsley will still do well with a few hours of sun.
